paragraphs: Swamiji taught that the human body is the finest body in the whole universe, and a human being the highest of all beings, above every animal and even above the angels.
According to Indian tradition, even the Devas, the gods, must one day come back and take a human birth to reach liberation. Only as human beings can anyone reach perfection.

He pointed out that the Jewish and Islamic traditions hold a similar idea in story form. God created the angels and everything else first, and then made man. He told the angels to come and honour the new creature. All of them bowed, except Iblis, who refused. For that he was cursed and became Satan.
Behind this old story, Swamiji said, lies a deep truth: being born human is the greatest birth any being can have.
learn: Your life as a human being, with the power to think, choose and grow, is a rare opportunity. Don't waste it feeling small; use it to become your best self.
